rust.name: crates/domain/src/idle.rs:141:102: replace < with <= in to_file
rust.why: This changes filing only at exactly seven days after closure, which tests using younger and older tasks would miss.

rust.name: crates/domain/src/idle.rs:148:33: replace || with && in to_file
rust.why: This can file a task with an empty kind, which well-formed task fixtures would miss.

rust.name: crates/domain/src/idle.rs:138:105: replace == with != in to_file
rust.why: This reverses which task kinds an open issue blocks, which tests starting with an empty issue list would miss.

rust.name: crates/domain/src/idle.rs:108:41: replace * with +
rust.why: This shortens the cooldown to about ten minutes and can survive tests that derive their timestamps from the same constant.

rust.name: crates/domain/src/idle.rs:141:97: replace - with + in to_file
rust.why: This adds the timestamps when checking the cooldown and can survive fixtures that set the closing timestamp to zero.
